positions.title: Java Developer Contract
positions.description:
Project: NEDSS Based System (NBS) - Centers for Disease Control and Prevention(CDC)

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is a United States federal agency under the Department of Health and Human Services near Atlanta, Georgia. NBS is a CDC-developed integrated information system that helps local, state, and territorial public health departments manage reportable disease data and send notifiable disease data to CDC. NBS provides a tool to support the public health investigation workflow and to process, analyze, and share disease-related health information. NBS also provides reporting jurisdictions with a NEDSS-compatible information system to transfer epidemiological, laboratory, and clinical data efficiently and securely over the Internet.

•	Exposed to Software Development Life Cycle (Scrum) with JIRA Agile following Agile methodology.
•	Designed and developed application based on Struts MVC framework. 
•	Configured Wild-Fly Application Server on multiple platforms for both horizontal and vertical scaling for Work Load Management and security purpose. 
•	Involved in developing the business logic using the session and entity beans and persistency layer classes with EJB3.0. 
•	Designed and developed the user interface using Struts View component, JSP, HTML5, CSS3, AngularJS, jQuery and JavaScript. 
•	Worked on XML using SAX and DOM parsers. 
•	Used XSL/XSLT for transforming PHDC(Public Health Document Container) and eCR(Electronic Case Reporting) XML documents coming from the Public Healthcare and Hospitals. 
•	Extensively worked on Batch files to execute application process remotely. 
•	Developed and Consumed the REST web services to collect and distribute data from various sources. 
•	Used SVN for version controlling and JUnit for unit testing. 
•	Used Apache Log4J logging API to log errors messages and ANT for build the application. 
•	Worked closely with requirement team, testing team, and data base administrators.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Marlabs provides information technology services in the mobility, analytics, cloud, business intelligence, cyber security, infrastructure, testing, application development, maintenance and digital asset management spaces. 


•	Designed and maintained web applications using various platforms and tools including Spring MVC, JSON, Hibernate, jQuery, JavaScript. 
•	Developed support documentation for applications and software patches created in-house. 
•	Created and presented customized queries and reports from databases. 
•	Developed a Single Page Application (SPA) for the Product Catalog module to quickly filter, select and compare various products using Spring MVC, AngularJS, Bootstrap CSS and HTML5. Produced and Consumed the REST web services to collect and distribute JSON data of the products for the MyCafe application build in ASP.NET and C#. 
•	Implemented JAVA/J2EE design patterns like DAO, Business Objects, Singleton, Factory thorough out the application to provide design solutions. 
•	Configured Maven dependencies for build automation and Log4j tool to log the entire application.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Triveni IT is a custom software development and IT consulting company with expertise in custom web application development, mobile application development, application maintenance, legacy application migration, application testing, and technology staffing services.

positions.title: Programmer Level 1
positions.description:
Translated functional requirements in to software designs and implement them within application development. 
•	Created and maintained API in the JavaScript. 
•	Wrote and maintained technical documentation to describe software architect, development, logic, coding, and testing. 
•	Worked on Disaster Analysis Project analyzing twitter feeds about Houston flood and Nepal Earthquake with Apache Hive and provided heat-map of tweet location visualized with d3.js and Google Map API.
•	Collected twitter log JSON data using Apache Flume and Python scripts and stored them on the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS). 
•	Produced a Data Visualization API with pure JavaScript, HTML, SVG, and CSS to make statistical visualization with multi-attributes including scatter chart, line chart and histogram.
